title: 薪资降温快过前两年：劳动力市场不喊通胀，美联储加息被谁按住？
speaker: Charlie

segments.en: Start to weaken equity sentiment on a more sustained basis then you have that negative well effect for consumption as well
segments.zh: 如果权益市场情绪持续走弱，也会对消费形成负面的财富效应。

segments.en: And the second part of it is that what inflation is hard. The labor market is sending very different signal
segments.zh: 第二点是通胀本身很顽固，但劳动力市场发出的信号却明显不同。

segments.en: We look at wage growth year-to-date has decelerated the faster pace than 2024 or 2025
segments.zh: 看今年以来的薪资增速，放缓速度比2024或2025年更快。

segments.en: And so the labor market is not telling you that it's a very worrying medium term inflation picture
segments.zh: 所以劳动力市场并没有告诉你，中期通胀图景非常令人担忧。

segments.en: And maybe that we are not in a state of the world where AI you know displays jobs
segments.zh: 也许我们并没有处在一个AI大规模取代岗位的世界里。

segments.en: But maybe it's constraining wage growth and that at the end of the day limit how far fat can hike and one last thing
segments.zh: 但它可能在抑制薪资增长，最终限制美联储还能加息多远。最后一点。

segments.en: I would mention is that I would work closely the treasury questionnaires to primary dealers that will be released this weekend on Friday
segments.zh: 我想提的是，我会密切关注本周末周五发布的财政部对一级交易商的问卷调查。

segments.en: Ahead of the November force quarterly refunding because that questionnaires will give you some sense of you know
segments.zh: 在11月季度再融资会议之前，这份问卷会让你对情况有所了解。

segments.en: What is the treasury plan is it going to be reducing some line propos issuance increased buybacks
segments.zh: 财政部的计划是什么，是减少某些期限的发行，还是增加回购。

segments.en: Or we have seen quite a bit of noise in the market recently about potential more drastic action to cancel the 20-year papers
segments.zh: 或者近期市场有不少噪音，讨论可能采取更激进的行动取消20年期品种。
